title: SAUCE FOR PUDDINGS
instructions: --Beat the whites of three eggs until stiff, add one-half cup powdered sugar and the grated yellow rind of half a lemon. Pour on slowly one cup of boiling water, stiring all the time and the sauce is ready to serve.
